question.worked_solution:
The given repeating decimal can be expressed as

$$
\begin{aligned}3.\overset{―}{7} & =3.777… \\  & =3+0.7+0.07+0.007+… \\  & =3+(\frac{7}{10}+\frac{7}{100}+\frac{7}{1\,000}+…).\end{aligned}
$$

The series in the parentheses is a geometric series with first term ${a}_{1}=\frac{7}{10}$ and common ratio $r=\frac{1}{10}.$ Therefore,

$$
\begin{aligned}3.\overset{―}{7} & =3+{\sum }_{n=1}^{\infty }{a}_{1}{r}^{n-1} \\  & =3+{\sum }_{n=1}^{\infty }\frac{7}{10}{(\frac{1}{10})}^{n-1} \\  & =3+{\sum }_{n=1}^{\infty }7(\frac{1}{10}){(\frac{1}{10})}^{n-1} \\  & =3+{\sum }_{n=1}^{\infty }7{(\frac{1}{10})}^{n}.\end{aligned}
$$
